c.html: Request a Demo

Randy Smith
Financial Services Company

The Bunchball to LumApps integration executed by Misha and his team at Ariella Digital Consulting helped our team collect the desired KPIs and drive user engagement across our platform. The widgets they've built are easy to use and scale across our many sub-sites for different audiences, missions and contests. The Ariella Digital Consulting team did a great job collaborating with us to delivery the technical integration and capability we needed to serve our customers.

nodes.html: OVERVIEW
Use Case

One of the underlying success factors of an Employee Experience platform is knowing how to keep employees engaged and motivated. ADC's LumApps to Nitro Studio Bunchball integration makes it very easy for employees to be recognized, see their scores for completed tasks (Missions), receive badges, and get rewarded.

c.html: WHY USE IT
Business Value

Increased Engagement to 76% within a LumApps Communities

 

Engages and motivates employees

Increases user adoption 

Sustains engagement with measurable goals and missions

Mature rewards and recognition system with badges for accomplishing Missions
